einzeiler: Actor Gal Gadot discusses her career, personal challenges, and life experiences.
kurzfassung: Actor Gal Gadot talks about her journey from winning a beauty pageant and studying law to becoming an action star. She discusses her near-quitting of acting and preparing physically for her role in The Runner. Additionally, she reflects on parenthood, aging, and the importance of struggle for happiness.
stichpunkte: Winning a beauty pageant unexpectedly and early media attention
Transitioning from studying law to auditioning for a Bond film
Reaching a point of almost quitting the acting profession
Recovering from a health issue and training with an Olympic running coach
Views on why struggle is essential to happiness
Experiences with parenthood and emotional changes through aging
beschreibung:
Gal Gadot (The Runner, Wonder Woman, Fast & Furious) is an actor, action star, and former pageant winner. Gal joins Armchair Expert to discuss unexpectedly winning a beauty pageant, being thrust onto the front page of the New York Post at 21, and surviving cerebral venous thrombosis after the birth of her fourth child. Gal and Dax talk about being discovered for a Bond audition while studying law, reaching the point where she was ready to quit acting, and going from recovering in bed to training with an Olympic running coach for The Runner. Gal explains why struggle is essential to happiness, how parenthood constantly forces you to adapt, and why getting older can open you up emotionally.
